headline: Recommended final passage of a $146,617.94 supplemental appropriation to the Opioid Abatement Expendable Trust Fund.
summary: Insurance firm HUB International presented a review of the city's self-funded health plan. The presentation covered fiscal year 2026 spending, rising claim costs, and possible next steps such as lower-cost care sites and biosimilar drugs.
decisions: Recommended final passage of $146,617.94 in FY2027 unanticipated revenue into Fund #7024, on a motion that carried.
